rationale: The previous iteration's geometry with sensor spread ±0.045 m and sensor size 0.016 m showed excellent performance on the oval track with full completion, zero line loss events, and low RMS error. However, on the s-bend track, the robot still went off track with one line loss event and only 68.75% progress. This suggests the controller struggled with tighter curves and noise. To improve stability and reduce noise, I narrowed the sensor spread slightly to ±0.04 m while keeping the sensor size at 0.016 m for robust detection. The rest of the geometry remains unchanged to preserve stability. Controller tuning was adjusted by lowering base_speed from 1.1 to 1.05 to balance speed and control, and increasing integral gain ki from 0.8 to 1.0 to enhance steady-state error correction in curves. Proportional and derivative gains remain at kp=9.0 and kd=1.2, and sensor weights are kept symmetric and proportional to sensor positions. Line loss behavior remains 'search_left' to steer right on line loss. Observation requests include completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and completion_time to evaluate performance comprehensively.
